text: What if you dug a hole in your backyard...
At one meter, you'd hit tree roots, worms... maybe even treasure.
At ten meters, the soil turns to wet clay...
At one hundred meters, you could find dinosaur fossils millions of years old.
At one kilometer, the rock is already hot to the touch.
At twelve kilometers, you'd beat the deepest hole ever dug.
The rock down there is a hundred and eighty degrees.
But you're not even through the crust yet.
Keep going, and you'd hit molten rock.
